findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (RCS 758)
findings.note: Member's recorded vote on the House second-reading vote of HB 958, a bill making many election-law changes. The ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) has a process to remove voters flagged by federal databases as potentially non-citizens (Section 2.3(b)), and Section 163-83 requires voter registration applications to state citizenship, with a sworn statement and a 30-day deadline if the answer is blank. The bill does not change photo ID rules in the pages read. Vote page was fetched; the vote line is the member's own row.
